title: Wishes, Regrets & Complaints

vocab.ex: She has no regrets about her decision.
I regret not studying harder.
I wish I had not turned down the offer.
If only I had known!
She wishes she had taken the job.
I wish I hadn't said that.
If only I hadn't been so stubborn.
This is a common complaint about neighbors.
I wish you would stop interrupting me.
His habit is really annoying.
Wish + would complains about someone's behaviour.
I wish my neighbour would turn down the music.
I wish it would stop raining.
My neighbour is very noisy.
I wish it would stop raining.
Wish + would expresses irritation.
The past is unchangeable, but we can still regret it.
He felt deep regret about the missed opportunity.
I wish I hadn't made that mistake.
I wish I had taken that opportunity.
I wish I had apologized sooner.
I wish I had not wasted so much time.
It was a missed chance I still think about.
In hindsight, I wish I had chosen differently.
I wish I had started sooner.
I wish I had studied harder.
I would have done it differently.
You can't change the past, but you can learn from it.
I wish he wouldn't be so loud.
I wish people had more patience.

grammar.title: Wish + Past Perfect (arrependimentos) & Wish + Would (reclamações)
rules: Para arrependimento sobre o PASSADO, use WISH + PAST PERFECT (had + particípio): I wish I had studied harder.
'If only' funciona igual a 'wish', mas é mais enfático: If only I had known!
Para reclamar do comportamento de OUTRA pessoa ou situação, use WISH + WOULD: I wish you would stop interrupting me.
Não use WISH + WOULD para si mesmo: ❌ I wish I would be taller → ✅ I wish I were taller.
